```{r}
#| label: pilotierung_abschnitte
#| results: asis
performance_text <- readLines("archive/texts/pilotierung_leistung.qmd", encoding = "UTF-8")
if (config$scope %in% c("pilotierung", "haupttest_struktur", "bericht")) {
  # Keep the editable chapter heading and insert design/sample before performance.
  start <- grep("^## .*\\{#pilotierung_leistung\\}", performance_text)
  if (length(start) != 1L || start < 2L) {
    stop("pilotierung_leistung.qmd braucht eine Kapitelüberschrift und die Abschnitts-ID {#pilotierung_leistung}.")
  }
  cat(knitr::knit_child(text = performance_text[seq_len(start - 1L)],
                        envir = environment(), quiet = TRUE), sep = "\n")
  for (block in eatTechReport:::study_text_names()) {
    cat(knitr::knit_child(file.path("archive/texts", block),
                          envir = environment(), quiet = TRUE), sep = "\n")
  }
  for (block in c("pilotierung_durchfuehrung.qmd", "pilotierung_auswertung.qmd")) {
    path <- file.path("archive/texts", block)
    if (file.exists(path)) {
      cat(knitr::knit_child(path, envir = environment(), quiet = TRUE), sep = "\n")
    }
  }
  performance_text <- performance_text[start:length(performance_text)]
  cat("\n\n{{< pagebreak >}}\n\n")
}
cat(knitr::knit_child(text = performance_text,
                      envir = environment(), quiet = TRUE), sep = "\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: haupttest_abschnitte
#| results: asis
if (config$scope %in% c("haupttest_struktur", "bericht")) {
  cat("\n\n{{< pagebreak >}}\n\n")
  for (block in c("haupttest_auswahl.qmd", "haupttest_module.qmd")) {
    cat(knitr::knit_child(file.path("archive/texts", block),
                          envir = environment(), quiet = TRUE), sep = "\n")
  }
  if (config$scope == "bericht") {
    for (block in eatTechReport:::report_completion_text_names()) {
      cat(knitr::knit_child(file.path("archive/texts", block),
                            envir = environment(), quiet = TRUE), sep = "\n")
    }
  }
}
```
